content.user_title: Build Applications Through a Structured Workflow
content.value_statement: Complex application delivery requires coordinated decisions across architecture, implementation, testing, and deployment. This skill organizes those stages and routes work to specialized development skills.
actual_capabilities: Organizes delivery into setup, frontend, backend, database, testing, review, and deployment phases.
Recommends specialized skills for React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, databases, testing, containers, and CI/CD.
Provides prompts for scaffolding projects, designing architectures, implementing components, configuring tests, and deploying applications.
Defines quality gates for tests, code review, security scans, linting, formatting, and documentation.
Maps common technology stacks to focused combinations of development skills.
limitations: Coordinates other named skills but does not include their implementation details.
Does not verify whether referenced skills are installed or available.
Does not replace project-specific testing, security review, or deployment validation.
Requires clear requirements, permissions, technology choices, and success criteria.

use_cases.title: Launch a full-stack product
use_cases.description: Plan setup, frontend, backend, database, testing, and deployment for a new product.

use_cases.title: Modernize a web application
use_cases.description: Coordinate refactoring, component updates, API changes, test coverage, and quality checks.

use_cases.title: Prepare a release pipeline
use_cases.description: Connect containerization, continuous integration, security scanning, and production deployment steps.

prompt_templates.title: Scaffold a web project
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workflow for a [project type] using [frontend] and [backend]. Include setup, required skills, and initial quality checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginning a new application with a defined stack.

prompt_templates.title: Implement a full-stack feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a [feature] across UI, API, database, and tests. Identify the specialized skill for each phase and define completion checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Adding a feature to an existing application.

prompt_templates.title: Modernize a legacy application
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased modernization plan for [application]. Cover architecture, migration risks, testing, security review, deployment, and rollback validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Refactoring an application while controlling delivery risk.

prompt_templates.title: Design a production delivery plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Coordinate delivery for [system] with [constraints]. Define architecture decisions, dependencies, quality gates, CI/CD stages, security checks, observability, and release criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Planning an advanced production system across multiple disciplines.

output_examples.input: Plan a new full-stack application with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
output: Setup: define requirements, select the stack, scaffold the repository, and configure version control.
Delivery: build frontend, backend, and database layers with focused skills.
Quality: run tests, review code, scan security, update documentation, and validate deployment.

output_examples.input: Add secure authentication to an existing web application.
output: Architecture: define session, authorization, and API requirements before implementation.
Implementation: coordinate frontend flows, backend middleware, database changes, and authentication patterns.
Validation: test critical paths, review security controls, and confirm deployment configuration.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Next.js application for production deployment.
output: Review application quality, tests, security scans, and documentation.
Create the container or platform configuration and establish the CI/CD workflow.
Validate environment variables, deployment behavior, monitoring, and release criteria.

best_practices: Confirm requirements, permissions, stack choices, and success criteria before selecting workflow phases.
Complete each quality gate before moving to the next delivery phase.
Validate generated work in the actual development, testing, and deployment environments.
anti_patterns: Do not invoke every referenced skill when the task needs only a focused subset.
Do not deploy generated changes without tests, security checks, and environment validation.
Do not continue when requirements, permissions, or release criteria remain unclear.

faq.question: What types of projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports web, mobile, backend, full-stack, modernization, testing, and deployment workflows.

faq.question: Does this skill write application code directly?
faq.answer: It primarily organizes work and recommends specialized skills that can guide implementation.

faq.question: Which technology stacks are covered?
faq.answer: The workflow names React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Prisma, React Native, Flutter, and iOS development.

faq.question: Does it include testing and security checks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes unit, integration, end-to-end, code review, linting, and static security analysis phases.

faq.question: Can it deploy an application automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides deployment workflow prompts, but actual deployment depends on available tools, credentials, permissions, and project configuration.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the project type, requirements, technology stack, constraints, available skills, permissions, and success criteria.
